ios.desc:
Hear the stories of the places around you. Audiala is your AI tour guide: 43,800+ audio guides in 107 countries, in 11 languages, with an AI trip planner and city downloads you can listen to offline.

HOW IT WORKS

Open the map or the list to find the stories closest to you and play one with a tap. Start a walk and, as you approach each place, its story can start on its own. Download a city's audio guides before you go and listen without data.

AI TRIP PLANNING

Tell us what you want, like "3 hours in Rome with kids, focus on ancient history", and get a custom itinerary in under a minute. Ask our AI anything about monuments, neighborhoods or local tips while you explore.

WHAT YOU GET

- Nearby stories: see what's around you and play it with one tap
- Stories on your walks: during a walk, a nearby place's story can play as you approach it
- 43,800+ audio guides: museums, palaces, parks, churches, bridges, ruins, theaters and more, built from Wikipedia, Wikidata and national heritage registers including UNESCO
- Offline audio: download a city's guides and listen without internet (maps, AI chat and trip planning need a connection)
- 11 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Czech, Hindi, Russian
- AI chat: ask anything about a place or get travel advice
- Trip briefing: a quick overview of a city before you visit
- Badges and streaks as you explore
- Lock-screen and headphone controls

START FREE

Everything is unlocked on the day you install. After that, choose a 7-day Trip Pass or a monthly or annual subscription. No ads.

Your next trip deserves more than a Wikipedia rabbit hole.

android.desc:
Your personal audio guide, in your pocket. Audiala turns every city into a self-guided tour — audio stories for 150,000+ places in 1,900+ cities, in 11 languages, with an AI trip planner that maps out your perfect day.

Follow a curated walking tour through the historic center, or wander freely and see the stories of the places around you. Turn on auto-play and, with the app open, a place's story starts as you get close. Download a city's audio guides in advance and listen with no signal (maps, planning and AI chat need a connection).

PLAN YOUR TRIP WITH AI
Tell Audiala "I'm in Prague for a day — astronomical clock, the famous bridge, and a beer with a view" and get a real, walkable itinerary in under a minute. Unlike generic AI planners, Audiala builds your day from real places — its sourced catalog plus live map data — so there are no made-up landmarks.

LISTEN TO THE WORLD
• 150,000+ places with AI-narrated stories built from real sources — 44,000+ of them with a full written guide on audiala.com — history, legends, architecture, local context
• Choose your narrator's voice and your language (English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Português, 日本語, 中文, Čeština, हिन्दी, Русский)
• Curated walking tours: follow expert routes through the old town, or build your own

TRAVEL TOGETHER
• Multi-day trips with a day-by-day plan, weather forecast and one-tap adjustments
• Invite your travel companions — everyone sees the same plan
• Swipe to replace any stop; ask the AI to rework a whole day

ALWAYS WITH YOU
• Download audio guides and listen offline — perfect for roaming-free travel
• A daily "Today" brief tuned to the weather, the time of day, and who you're with
• Map view with monuments, tours and your itinerary's walking route
• Missing a monument? Request it and Audiala researches, writes and records the guide in minutes

Popular destinations: Paris, Rome, London, Barcelona, Prague, Vienna, Budapest, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Kyoto, Istanbul — and 1,900+ cities in all.

FAIR & SIMPLE
Start free: everything is unlocked on the day you install. After that, a 7-day Trip Pass or one subscription unlocks every guide in every city — no per-tour purchases.

Whether it's your first weekend in Paris or your tenth time in Tokyo, Audiala makes you feel like you travel with a brilliant local friend — one who never gets tired of your questions.

Download Audiala and turn your next walk into a journey.

quotes.text:
I built Audiala [1][2][3], which is a platform that creates virtual tour guides that goes with you anywhere in the world. While the content is mostly static now, the pipeline is there to make it entirely personal for each user, once I figured out how to deal with the API costs.

The next steps are to adapt the content based on realtime user feedback or queries like "What happened on this street during the French Revolution?" or "Tell me more about this building’s history." as well as offering step by step itinerary suggestions.

I believe it's now possible to build an Augmented Reality solution, where you leave your phone in your pocket, put some airpods and you listen or converse with your personal tour guide and fully immerse yourself in history.

[1] https://audiala.com

[2] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6446038181?uo=4

[3] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.audiala.audioguide&hl=en
